about: What the person is told after sending a message to one AI (src/work-messages.mjs). {app} becomes the AI's name. Each line matches how the AI can be reached: the stream route (a helper on its computer holds Trillion's live connection), an address Trillion posts to, or nothing until it next connects (a chat app on the web). src/agent-delivery.mjs says which.

sent.stream_live: Sent to {app}. It is on your computer now and its reply will appear here.
sent.stream_away: {app} is not reachable right now, so your message is saved for it. To reach it at once, run node harness/wake-sessions.mjs on the computer it runs on.
sent.push: Trillion is reaching {app} and has not heard back yet.
sent.next_connection: Saved for {app}. It will see your message the next time it connects to Trillion.
sent.not_confirmed: Your message is saved, but Trillion could not confirm delivery to {app}. It will still be available the next time it connects.

later.delivered: Trillion reached the AI. It has not confirmed reading your message.
later.dead: Trillion could not reach the AI. Your message is saved for its next connection.
later.waiting: Trillion is still trying to reach the AI and has not heard back yet.
